acceptance: The 14-day bucket-agreement measurement (or the owner's decision) is recorded before design.
If built: CI and local classification both come from the host, the runner no longer receives TYPESAFE_API_KEY, and a host outage leaves CI behaviour unchanged (tests and live evidence).
context: Re-homed from the deferred 'move classification off the runner' step of the 2026-10-25 proposal (local://oracle-queue/second-review-response.md) so the narrowing is recorded.
description:
Deferred from the 2026-10-25 oracle job-structure proposal. Today select-1 calls TypeSafe directly with TYPESAFE_API_KEY on the runner (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/jev.py:31; oracle-jev-gateway-gap), and local reviews without the key fall back to a fixed bucket. Serving classification from the gateway host would remove the key from runners and give local and cloud reviews CI's buckets.

Decision gate: build only if, after oracle-verdict-single-job-20261025 and oracle-local-prepr-review-20261025 land, measurement over 14 days shows that default-classified local reviews choose a different bucket from CI's on at least a quarter of PRs, or the owner decides the runner key exposure matters. Record the measurement first. Upstream blocker: omp auth-gateway does not serve judge-kind models (oracle-jev-gateway-gap); the host service may need its own endpoint.

Guardrails: no change to bucket semantics or policy; fail closed to today's behaviour when the host is unreachable; owner decision before any new host service.
